newPersistentHistory.authority: Existing immutable commands/revisions/snapshots journal. One SQL read snapshot for head+chronology; cursor not a separate memory/disk authority, no new SQL tables/migration.
newPersistentHistory.inverse: Tip/full-content equivalence excluding only Project.revision, restore saved before image with fresh monotonic revision, exact entity versions and existing max(version)+1 on reedit. Redo restores saved undo before-image, not reexecution.
newPersistentHistory.atomic: Existing writer-fence/revision/idempotency/definitions/pins/receipt/event/outbox transaction; late SQL failure no cursor mutation. Two actual independent concurrent SQLite contenders one win/one REVISION_CONFLICT.
newPersistentHistory.branch: New changed edit clears logical redo without deleting audit/history/blob pins. No-op leaves redo available. Same-key retry returns receipt, not double execution.
newPersistentHistory.legacy: Legacy undoLatest remains unchanged API and actual historical restoration transition, traversed rather than rewritten. Actual old store+document seq.version0 ambiguity fourundo/fourredo/reedit/raw rows and old snapshots byte exact tested.
newPersistentHistory.durability: File DB reopen preserves undo and redo. Three actual SIGKILLs: two explicit instrumented mirror pre-COMMIT barriers, one unmodified post-COMMIT; unmodified current reopen after each. No production fault hooks.
newPersistentHistory.media: Actual SDK A/V+extracted AudioClip/link, crop/color, captions and persistent proxy snapshots restored by exact content hashes, durable reopen. Caption explicitly undone before MP4 so no unsupported burn-in or silent omission. Actual preview/preencoder equality/AAC MP4. Archive fork preserves resources and starts fresh local undo/redo per original spec. Real Flutter UI multiundo/redo/save/fork/preview/export.
newPersistentHistory.deepHistory: 1000 seeded title edits then1000 undo and1000 redo, every contentHash equal and revision3000; not complete randomized NLE operation matrix.
newPersistentHistory.refusal: Malformed JSON and valid-inputHash unknown control version explicitly HISTORY_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED, no dropped history. Stale revision/writer, non-tip IDs and branch-invalidated redo refuse. Historical unsupported semantics must pass unchanged writable admission.
newPersistentHistory.limits: O(n) journal folding per query with O(n) IDs, no large-history realtime performance claim. Full-root conservative serialization, not field-aware collaboration/rebase or gesture coalescing.
